title: Qt: Add an "x-reset" icon and use to reset extcap options.
description:
Add an "x-reset" stock icon and use it instead of Qt's SP_BrowserReload
icon to reset extcap options.

Add an "x-reset" stock icon and use it instead of Qt's SP_BrowserReload
icon to reset extcap options.
